title: Former KGB Agent Yuri Bezmenov Explains How to Brainwash a Nation (Full Length)
summary: A long interview with former KGB agent Yuri Bezmenov describing what he calls ideological subversion, a process of demoralizing a nation. He claims it works by influencing academia and media over years.
why: HN commenters mostly cite it in political threads as a theory of subversion, and several mentions are repeated drive-by posts.

quote.text: talks about his mission and how he brainwashes the whole nation by controlling the academia and media.
